messages.author: e302709dad51d37a
messages.subject: Simmer Optim Error
parts:
Hi there,

I am trying to test the simmer.optim package and am running into a couple issues.

I tried using the .opt function when adding resources but got an error that it did not exist, so I switched to the opt_func function and am getting a different error:

    add_resource('filler_to_lidder'     , capacity = opt_func(params = 'fl_conveyor')             , queue_size = 0) %>%

produces the error:

    Error: add_resource: 'capacity' is not a valid number or schedule

Any insight on this?

Best,
John

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Simmer Optim Error
parts:
On Wed, 3 Oct 2018 at 15:49, John Redmond <john.re...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> Hi there,
>
> I am trying to test the simmer.optim package and am running into a couple issues.
>
> I tried using the .opt function when adding resources but got an error that it did not exist,
.opt doesn't exist, it's just a placeholder.
> so I switched to the opt_func function and am getting a different error:

opt_func is for internal use, and it shouldn't be exported. .opt is
the way to go, and then opt_func internally substitutes the .opt
appearances with the proper value for each run. But note that the
simmer model must be encapsulated inside a function. See the README
for a complete example. Hope it helps.

>
> add_resource('filler_to_lidder' , capacity = opt_func(params = 'fl_conveyor') , queue_size = 0) %>%
>
> produces the error:
>
> Error: add_resource: 'capacity' is not a valid number or schedule
>
> Any insight on this?
>
> Best,
> John
>
